Gain <@ba.vup>180</> <$ba.dmgresistance>Damage Reduction</>; If equipped by an [Ægir] Operator, deals <@ba.vup>50%</> of equipped Operator's ATK as Arts damage to damage source when damage is taken (Triggers up to once every 0.5s)
